sentences.en: People are suffering from the contamination of the water supply.
sentences.zh: 人们正遭受供水污染的折磨。

sentences.en: It is essential to prevent salmonella contamination in hen egg production.
sentences.zh: 防止鸡蛋生产中沙门氏菌污染至关重要。

sentences.en: Radioactive contamination was detected in spinach and edible chrysanthemum.
sentences.zh: 菠菜和食用菊花被检测出放射性污染。
